brief:
The Palestine Center for Prisoner Studies reported that Israeli occupation forces have issued more than 6,500 administrative detention orders since the beginning of 2024, Shehab Wire reported. Administrative detention allows authorities to imprison individuals without charge or trial for renewable periods.

The surge represents a significant escalation in the use of the controversial detention mechanism, which human rights groups have long criticized as a tool enabling indefinite imprisonment without judicial review.
